answer: The canyon counter is kept in spiral and gale shows each reset. An farming party hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 923 identities would post 1060 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
